description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is hiring a Software Engineer specializing in Application Support to support mission-critical software applications. The role provides first-line triage, troubleshooting, escalation, stakeholder coordination, and operational support for legacy systems, including applications handling classified or sensitive data.
Application Support Software Engineer supporting an assigned application portfolio through incident triage, legacy production diagnostics, escalation, and operational documentation

Responsibilities:
• Monitor assigned applications; respond to incidents; validate user environments, review logs, and perform basic diagnostics; document findings with proper handling marks/access controls
• Collaborate with multiple application development, operations, and support teams across the portfolio to coordinate triage, share contextual incident data, and align resolutions across dependent systems; serve as communication bridge to prevent duplicated efforts and ensure consistent escalation handling
• Act as primary technical point of contact for assigned application portfolio; manage expectation setting, provide regular status updates to program stakeholders, and coordinate ticket prioritization
• Categorize incidents by impact/urgency; escalate complex or security-sensitive issues to Tier 2/3 with complete audit trails and root-cause summaries; ensure compliance with program-specific playbooks and change-control procedures
• Provide maintenance and operational support for legacy software stacks; diagnose issues in Production environments while working closely with Developers to address complex issues and support software development activities
• Maintain and update runbooks, FAQs, and security-conscious support guides; ensure legacy-specific procedures (e.g., offline patching, data reformatter scripts) are current and auditable
• Participate in on-call rotations per program requirements; support audit readiness by maintaining accurate incident logs and access records

Requirements:
• Experience in technical support, help desk, or application support
• Strong written/verbal communication skills for interacting with cleared personnel, application users, and stakeholders
• Basic familiarity with ticketing systems and monitoring tools
• Applicant must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Clearance. No clearance needed to start this position
• US Citizenship Required

Preferred:
• preferably in a government or cleared contractor environment
• Experience supporting defense software systems legacy applications
• Exposure to account management functions, customer-success metrics, or technical liaison roles
• Foundational knowledge of legacy modernization patterns, technical-debt assessment, or legacy-to-modernization migration
• Scripting or automation experience for legacy environment validation (PowerShell, Python, Bash)
• Experience with Atlassian Toolsets (Jira, Confluence)
• Experience with Databases (Oracle SQL, MySQL)
• Experience with RedHat Linux environments
• Experience working in classified restricted areas
• Familiarity with security clearance processes, NDA/COMSEC basics, and CUI handling procedures
• Ability to work within structured, procedure-driven environments with attention to audit/compliance requirements
